benchmarks.label: How closely does the reconstructed neutral-state BDE association fit DPPH values?
benchmarks.context: Calculated from rounded Table 1 values in Lauberte et al. (2019). This is one declared reconstruction; state mapping, exclusions and OH normalization are sensitivity analyses. It is not external predictive validation.

benchmarks.label: Do the reported 800 degC thermal values agree with the prose?
benchmarks.context: Kazachenko et al. (2022), Table 2. The prose reverses these two values. This is a source-internal inconsistency; the available table does not establish which statement reflects the raw experiment.
